fleurs_60.input_note: Historical 60 rows (59 unique WAVs); en_us-000001797 appears twice under the same staged filename.

longform_30s_300s.input_note: Historical stress set. The 300 s tail reference included words outside the truncated source and the stereo Apple run read the quiet channel; exclude these from fair comparisons.

longform_norm_30s_300s.input_note: Stitched read utterances with target -20 dBFS RMS and a peak cap, including repeated stems and a 48 kHz derivative. Limited recording diversity.

streaming_resampling_final.fix: VoiceAudio.mono16k() chunks non-16 kHz audio into reusable 15 s AVAudioConverter buffers inside autoreleasepool while keeping FIR filter continuity (zero .reset()) and 16 kHz fast path

longform_diagnostic_findings.issue_1_unnormalized_long_audio_attenuat: Stress fixture sources differ by up to ~42 dB in RMS. Per-utterance gain matching before assembly is a corpus intervention.
longform_diagnostic_findings.issue_2_fluidaudio_chunk_merge_and_splic: 20.56 s is a position in the recording. The missing clause is about five seconds long and already absent in the per-window decoder outputs. The same missing passage repeats at shared offsets in the 30, 60, 180 and 300 s English recordings. Separate seam corruption survives in the splice logic, with additional token-order corruption from the final sort.
longform_diagnostic_findings.issue_3_onset_padding_rejected: Empirical ablation (+200ms zero-padding on Round 3 held n=168) worsened WER from 14.151% to 15.002% (pt-conversation 21.823% -> 23.620%) and was NOT shipped.
longform_diagnostic_findings.issue_4_channel_selection: MicBuffer active-channel selection picked loud channel 1 on 48kHz stereo tests (WER 5.143%), whereas naive first-channel reads failed (WER 100%).

external_competitor_context_non_paired.caveat: Published vendor figures (Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, Monologue, Aqua Voice, Typeless, Handy, VoiceInk, FluidVoice) are NOT paired apples-to-apples with verbatim ASR WER when formatted with LLMs (ZER/AMEND).

cannot_claim: Relative quality or physical interaction latency of complete dictation apps.
Five-minute lossless speech, spontaneous long dictation coverage, or microphone/AX/clipboard hardware coverage from WAV probes.
Physical Bluetooth HFP/A2DP, real AX insertion and key-to-first-frame latency from instrumented endpoints.
Portable WER, energy or latency conclusions across macOS versions and hardware.
paired_comparison_scope: Identical corpus inputs where channel selection matches, same Mac, separate engine runners. These are engine comparisons and do not measure commercial apps, their formatting, release packaging, or physical interaction.

e2e_endpoint_definitions.shortcut_to_ready: Synchronous permission, AX trust and session checks only. Excludes key handling, microphone startup and first frame.
e2e_endpoint_definitions.finish_to_transcript: Predelivered PCM through model preparation, inference, cleanup and transcript sanitizer; excludes microphone drain and finish padding.
e2e_endpoint_definitions.finish_to_scratchpad: Finish-to-transcript plus isolated SQLite create/fetch; no panel or editor focus measurement.
e2e_endpoint_definitions.finish_to_dictate: Finish-to-transcript plus formatting and writing to a unique pasteboard; no external AX insertion, Cmd-V fallback or target rendering.
e2e_endpoint_definitions.quantile: Nearest rank from the original JSON; warm n=15, so p95 is the maximum (169.335 ms to transcript).

final_reliability.platform: Mac15,6 M3 Pro, 18 GiB, macOS 26.5.1 (25F80), Release RascBench, local pinned model; all 21 asset hashes checked

scoring_notes: Word edits use the Round 5 tokenizer against the given reference. Longest contiguous deletion uses minimum edit alignment and counts words, not seconds.

Ordered exact-match coverage uses the same alignment. A reference span is below half if fewer than half of its reference words match in order. Span duration is annotated source time, not recovered speech milliseconds.

Adjacent duplicate insertions count alignment insertions that duplicate an adjacent word run. A span boundary metric counts unmatched reference words within one word of a corpus utterance boundary. Neither replaces listening.

The 25-clip matrix uses read/staged inputs, with genuine within-clip PT/EN switches from CS-FLEURS. Dense variants reuse utterances across durations. Samples do not establish failure rates for spontaneous live recording.
No active long-run efficiency study, microphone, Bluetooth or external AX delivery result is inherited by this follow-up.

instrumented_endpoint_recheck.scope: Same VoiceArena 15-case protocol as Round 5. Software measurements with final VoiceAudio and VoiceModel code; see e2e_endpoint_definitions.
